name: Mispar
title: One of those who returned from exile
summary: Mispar (also known as Mispereth) was one of the Israelites who returned to Judah from the Babylonian exile together with Zerubbabel. He is mentioned in the list of those who returned in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah. He is one of the many nameless heroes who contributed to the rebuilding of the Jewish community after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Listed among those who returned from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Mispar is mentioned in the list of those who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem and Judah together with Zerubbabel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Mispereth in Nehemiah's list
keyEvents.description: In Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from exile, he is listed under the name Mispereth, showing that he was a recognized person among the returnees.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Mispar was part of the first large group that returned from the Babylonian captivity under the leadership of Zerubbabel, a turning point in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Community
keyEvents.description: As part of the returnees, Mispar contributed to the rebuilding of the Jewish community in Judah and Jerusalem after 70 years of exile.
